endpoints.endpointName: Noblewood Park cartop launch / Boquet mouth access area
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: boquet_river_willsboro_noblewood boquet-river-noblewood-park-take-out: Lakes to Locks publishes the Nature Preserve-to-mouth Blueway segment. The Nature Conservancy identifies the public launch area on Gilliland Lane, and the Empire State Water Trail lists Noblewood Park as a public cartop launch at the Boquet mouth. The stored Noblewood point is a park/access-area anchor, not a surveyed water-edge coordinate. Verify seasonal hours, fees, and the marked river landing; do not infer permission to land on private shoreline or camp at the preserve.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (boquet_river_willsboro_noblewood boquet-river-noblewood-park-take-out) on Boquet River; treat the agency parking/carry anchor as on/near-water evidence, but confirm the exact water entry and landing before launch.
